submission.justification:
Algorithm-L3 at 43 GeV has the highest recorded signal efficiency (92.274%, refined scan), ahead of L1 (best 84.177% at 30 GeV) and L2 (best 74.227% at 30 GeV). All three candidates are recorded as deployable in Level-1 hardware, and no algorithm-specific threshold restrictions were found. The threshold lies within the 20-60 GeV window.

Caveat on the rate constraint: the recorded results contain no measured trigger rate for any algorithm or threshold. The only rate value is recorded_rate_khz = 8, which matches the allocation and is not a measurement. The 8 kHz target is therefore unverified, and the efficiency ranking assumes comparable rates across algorithms, which has not been demonstrated. The 43 GeV point is also a fine scan on a small margin over 42 GeV (92.098%), so it is within the range where statistical noise could matter. Before deployment, the rate at 43 GeV should be measured on minimum-bias or zero-bias data and confirmed to be at or below 8 kHz.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L3 is one of the three recorded candidates (L1, L2, L3).

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be deployable in Level-1 trigger hardware
requirements.evidence: deployable_Algorithm-L3 = 1 is recorded. The recorded flags do not include resource-level detail, so this relies on that flag.
Recommended threshold is 43 GeV; threshold_min_gev = 20 and threshold_max_gev = 60.
L3 at 43 GeV gives 92.274% versus best L1 84.177% (30 GeV) and best L2 74.227% (30 GeV). The 42 GeV point (92.098%) is essentially equivalent.

requirements.requirement: Goal: efficiency at the allocated trigger rate of 8 kHz
requirements.evidence: No measured rate is recorded for any algorithm or threshold. recommended_rate_khz = 8 only echoes the allocation. The rate at 43 GeV must be measured before this can be confirmed.
link_bandwidth_gbps = 25 is recorded, but no per-algorithm data-volume or bandwidth usage is recorded, so compatibility is not demonstrated.
